docs.text: Plan your visit · Kissimmee, Florida All Roads Lead to AMBAR Fly into one of three airports, ride Brightline up from Miami, or drive in. AMBAR sits on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy in Kissimmee, minutes from Walt Disney World. Here’s how to get here, when to come, and how to see the residences in person. docs.title: Three airports, one destination · Plan your visit (1/5)

docs.title: What is AMBAR Residences Orlando?
docs.text: The subject of this market landscape: branded residences in Orlando. Shown here in the Premium tier alongside Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio and peers. Trade coverage describes it as an Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy project.

docs.title: How hotel rates are gathered (methodology)
docs.text: Lowest public nightly rate observed: the lowest price shown for a one-night stay on a public booking site on the snapshot date. It is not ADR, it is not occupancy, and room types are often unspecified. Currency USD. Straight-line ('as the crow flies') distance from each hotel to EPCOT, computed from OpenStreetMap coordinates. It is not a driving distance. Figures are public lowest rates shown on trivago.com U.S. or Google Hotels at the time of the snapshot. Taxes are usually excluded and resort fees, parking and member-only prices can change the total. UNAVAILABLE means no offer was returned for that one-night search. It is a scarcity signal, not a confirmed hotel sell-out. NOT COLLECTED means the rate calendar returned no prices for that hotel and week. Weekly means are simple arithmetic means of the nights that showed a price. They are illustrative and are not ADR. Occupancy for individual hotels is not publicly available. Market occupancy shown in Demand Context is metro-wide (CoStar), not for these hotels. Rates are dynamic. Prices moved between page loads on some snapshot mornings (noted where the brief recorded it). Hyatt Regency Grand Cypress, Wyndham Grand Bonnet Creek, Conrad Orlando and ette were added on Oct 14, 2026. They have no rates for weeks before Oct 12, and nights before the add date (Oct 12–13) were not collected; their Oct 14–18 rates are Google Hotels lowest shown one-night prices captured on Oct 14. Key counts for Hyatt Regency Grand Cypress (779) and Wyndham Grand Bonnet Creek (400) are as provided by Callum Brown; Conrad Orlando (433) and ette (126) match their official fact sheets. Key counts for the Marriott hotels are not shown.

docs.title: Demand context · week of Oct 12, 2026
docs.text: Mon Oct 12: Columbus Day / Indigenous Peoples' Day (Holiday). Holiday Monday at the tail of fall break; Disney Tourist Blog calls it 'very busy'. Source: Disney Tourist Blog. Oct 9–17: Peak of fall break (Disney). Disney Tourist Blog expects crowd levels of 7–10 out of 10 at every park. Theme Park Forecast models Sat 17 and Sun 18 at 8/10. docs.text: Monthly normal daily high and low at Orlando International Airport (NOAA NCEI 1991–2020 normals) and typical theme-park crowd levels (Theme Park Direct crowd calendar): Jan high 72°F / low 50°F, crowds low; Feb high 75°F / low 52°F, crowds low; Mar high 79°F / low 56°F, crowds high; Apr high 84°F / low 61°F, crowds high; May high 88°F / low 66°F, crowds moderate; Jun high 91°F / low 72°F, crowds high; Jul high 92°F / low 73°F, crowds high; Aug high 92°F / low 74°F, crowds moderate; Sep high 90°F / low 72°F, crowds low; Oct high 85°F / low 66°F, crowds moderate; Nov high 78°F / low 58°F, crowds moderate; Dec high 74°F / low 53°F, crowds high.
docs.source: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals; Theme Park Direct
